# grl-replay-classifier-client

GRL replay classifier

- API version: 1.0.0

- Generator version: 7.28.0-SNAPSHOT

Classifies FastBuilder replays: POST /label returns a cluster label for each replay. GET /clusters describes every cluster with techniques and suspicion levels.


*Automatically generated by the [OpenAPI Generator](https://openapi-generator.tech)*

## Requirements

Building the API client library requires:

1. Java 11+
2. Maven/Gradle

## Installation

To install the API client library to your local Maven repository, simply execute:

```shell
mvn clean install
```

To deploy it to a remote Maven repository instead, configure the settings of the repository and execute:

```shell
mvn clean deploy
```

Refer to the [OSSRH Guide](http://central.sonatype.org/pages/ossrh-guide.html) for more information.

### Maven users

Add this dependency to your project's POM:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>grl</groupId>
  <artifactId>grl-replay-classifier-client</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.0</version>
  <scope>compile</scope>
</dependency>
```

### Gradle users

Add this dependency to your project's build file:

```groovy
compile "grl:grl-replay-classifier-client:1.0.0"
```

### Others

At first generate the JAR by executing:

```shell
mvn clean package
```

Then manually install the following JARs:

- `target/grl-replay-classifier-client-1.0.0.jar`
- `target/lib/*.jar`
